in_sanskrit.name: Motiram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Motiram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Moti means 'jewel' and Ram means 'God'. Motiram is a name that symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Motiram is associated with Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring wealth and abundance to one's life.
